summary: Wrote 6 regression tests for /api/chat/stream covering (1) no re-greeting on first message, (2) no re-greeting when user says 'hi', (3) session memory (iPhone across turns), (4) no self-repetition over 4 turns, (5) concise voice-friendly length, (6) Spanish reply with [[LANG:es]] marker and no greeting. ALL 6 tests were BLOCKED — could not verify the fix because the Emergent LLM key budget is exhausted. Every SSE call returned an error event: 'litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 1.437993, Max budget: 1.4'. Endpoint infrastructure itself is healthy: /api/chat/stream returns HTTP 200 and emits valid SSE 'data: {...}' frames including the error frame. Static review of the system prompt (server.py lines 563-582) shows the ABSOLUTE RULES section is present and correctly forbids all listed greetings ('Hi/Hello/Hey/How can I help/How can I assist/How are you doing/Good to see you') and repetition, and instructs LANG marker + memory usage. Fix looks correct in code; it just cannot be exercised against the live model until the LLM budget is topped up.
